method.name: get_status_string
method.description: kimodo does not use a status enum; it reports errors through [code skip-lint]kimodo_model_last_error[/code] on a loaded model. Until a follow-up PR wires load and free as separate calls, this method returns an empty string.

method.name: generate_motion
method.description: Text-to-motion. Loads the motion, text, and (optional) text-adapter GGUFs, runs the diffusion denoiser against [param prompt], returns a [Dictionary] with: [code skip-lint]frames[/code] ([int]), [code skip-lint]joints[/code] ([int]), [code skip-lint]local_rotations_xyzw[/code] ([PackedFloat32Array], frames * joints * 4), and [code skip-lint]root_positions[/code] ([PackedFloat32Array], frames * 3). [param opts] optional keys: [code skip-lint]threads[/code], [code skip-lint]device[/code] (0 auto, 1 CPU, 2 Vulkan), [code skip-lint]seed[/code], [code skip-lint]frames[/code] (default 120), [code skip-lint]diffusion_steps[/code] (default 30), [code skip-lint]text_cfg_weight[/code] (default 5.0), [code skip-lint]constraint_cfg_weight[/code] (default 1.0). Returns an empty [Dictionary] on any error; the reason is pushed through [method @GlobalScope.printerr] before returning.
